name: melaleuca cajuputi leaf oil + thymol
purpose: This product is intended to help prevent urinary tract infections (UTIs) and moisturize.
otcwarn:  if you are allergic to any ingredient in this product Stop use and ask a doctor if  rash or allergic reaction develops  vaginal symptoms develop  you get a rash or hives, abdominal pain, fever, chills, nausea or vomiting
